subject: CONFIRMED SOURCE GAP: exact-cycle frozen frame lacks semantic content freshness
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=reviewer-launcher-content-continuity-gen2-20261001. Revalidated against unchanged production main 45bb0d326899c0e08415928224cfea0ff58d2d4e and reconciled with primary Gen3 alpha1 checkpoint msg-primary-gen3-alpha1-integration-c2819b37. SOURCE_FINDING: Fold7ContinuityFrameStore FrameLease carries serviceEpoch/closeCycleId/captureSequence/contentLeaseId/dimensions/timing/source but no semantic content-context revision. current() validates cycle+dimensions+age. Fold7ContinuityCoordinator supplies FROZEN_FRAME_MAX_AGE_MS=10_000, and DisplayMirrorHost.bind() prefers an eligible frozen frame over the live SurfaceControl mirror. FoldOverlayService.onAccessibilityEvent is Unit. Therefore a frame may be perfectly exact-cycle yet semantically stale if foreground context changes after early PRIME but before COVER_VISUAL (e.g. app switch, launcher-page change, meaningful navigation). This is NOT a claim that ordinary pixel animation should stay live; deterministic frozen transition content remains intentional. The gap is semantic context invalidation. Gen3 direction: add semantic contextRevision + capturePurpose PRIME/VISUAL_REFRESH to the already-accepted service-stable capture owner; semantic dirtiness or a newer refresh immediately fences old frozen pixels; while freshness is unresolved, prefer live mirror as current-content bridge, then promote a fresh deterministic frame if still current. Accessibility window/scroll events can be low-cost invalidation hints but must not be sole proof. Samsung currently documents Cover screen mirroring for Z Fold7; use that as the native Home-layout synchronization mechanism rather than launcher automation/task movement. No production writes.
